zone.description: Name of the zone, lower case, without the dot at the end

provider.description: Name of the provider of the norca-provider configuration that serves the zone

endpoint.description: Base URL of the DNS contract of the zone

tokenVariable.description: Path of the Variable whose item token is the bearer token of the calls

records.description: Whether norca-dns may write the records of the zone (the records contract)

parameters.description: Published settings of the provider; never a secret

heartbeat.description: RFC 3339 time of the last heartbeat
